evals.name: fires-on-setup-apply
evals.prompt: /developer-experience:setup apply. I confirm the changes it shows.
evals.expected_output: The skill writes the developer tooling conventions file with a written_against front matter line and a source marker under every section except Not yet, and adds exactly one developer-experience pointer line inside the managed plugin-conventions block of the root AGENTS.md, changing no other AGENTS.md line.
expectations: The conventions file exists with front matter naming the developer-experience version it was written against
Every section of the conventions file except Not yet has a source marker on the line after its heading
AGENTS.md holds exactly one developer-experience pointer line inside the managed block and no other AGENTS.md line changed

evals.name: stays-quiet-without-the-slash-command
evals.prompt: Write down this repo's developer tooling conventions where coding agents will find them
evals.expected_output: The setup skill does not run; it runs only when the user invokes /developer-experience:setup.
expectations: The response makes no Skill call to developer-experience setup
The response does not write the developer-experience managed block pointer line into AGENTS.md
